name: Aha!
description: Set product strategy, capture customer feedback, prioritize your roadmap, define features, manage releases, and track progress in Aha! software. Bring that information into Claude for full context. Quickly search records, analyze trends, draft documents, and update plans as part of your AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aha! to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aha! to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://big.aha.io/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aha! MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aha! lists 14 MCP tools, including add_comment, analyze_records, copy_record, create_record_link, field_options_metadata, fields_metadata, find_project, get_report_columns_and_filters, get_report_data, get_report_filter_options, manage_record, and manage_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aha!?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aha! in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Aha! requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aha! is developed by Aha!. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
